# Really Good Designs

> > A curated collection of web design inspiration, tutorials, and best practices covering composition, color theory, visual hierarchy, and modern design trends.

Really Good Designs features design analysis and examples from leading brands like Apple, Linear, Notion, and ClickUp, with expert insights from design writers Sandra Boicheva and Iveta Pavlova. The site focuses on practical design principles, SaaS design patterns, and actionable tips for creating impactful web experiences.

## Key Topics

- composition-rules

## Design Principles & Fundamentals

- [15 Rules for Composition in Design You Can't Ignore](https://reallygooddesigns.com/composition-in-design): 15 composition tips by Sandra Boicheva for web design & visual hierarchy
- [Minimalist vs Colorful Website Design: Which Style is More Impactful in 2026?](https://reallygooddesigns.com/minimalist-vs-colorful-website): Iveta Pavlova compares minimalist vs colorful design impact for 2026 trends

## Website Design Examples & Inspiration

- [Above-the-Fold Website Examples: 20 Famous Brands & Tips](https://reallygooddesigns.com/above-the-fold-website-examples-20-famous-brands-tips): 20 hero section examples from brands like Monday.com with conversion tips
- [21 WordPress Magazine Website Examples for News, Media & Editorial Sites](https://reallygooddesigns.com/wordpress-magazine-website-examples): 21 WordPress magazine examples including TechCrunch & The Verge layouts

## Brand Identity & Logo Design

- [30 Travel Logo Examples To Inspire Your Brand's Journey](https://reallygooddesigns.com/travel-logo-examples): 30 travel logo examples from agencies like Montage Travel & Royal Seasons

## Marketing & Campaign Design

- [40 Email Newsletter Design Ideas You Can Steal for Your Next Campaign](https://reallygooddesigns.com/email-newslette-design-ideas): 40 email newsletter design ideas for marketing campaigns by Sandra Boicheva

## Optional

- [The Must-Have Guide on How to Hire a Developer for Your Projects](https://reallygooddesigns.com/how-to-hire-a-developer): Practical developer hiring guide covering React, Vue, Node.js & Laravel
